templates.name: New Lead Outreach
templates.subject: Hi {{customer_name}}, Looking to Sell or Let?
templates.body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

Thanks for your interest in VidaListing. We're here to help you sell or let your property.

Get a free valuation: https://vidalisting.co.uk/valuation

Best regards
The VidaListing Team

templates.name: Follow-up
templates.subject: Following up on your enquiry
templates.body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

I wanted to follow up on your recent enquiry. Have you had a chance to think about it?

Let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards
The VidaListing Team

templates.name: Interested Lead
templates.subject: Great choice! {{customer_name}}
templates.body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

Great to hear you're interested! Let me arrange a convenient time for a property viewing.

Best regards
The VidaListing Team

templates.name: Not Interested Response
templates.subject: No problem, {{customer_name}}
templates.body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

No problem at all. If you change your mind in the future, we'd be happy to help.

Best regards
The VidaListing Team

templates.name: Complaint/Review
templates.subject: RE: Your recent enquiry
templates.body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

Thank you for reaching out. I'd like to personally look into this for you.

Can you please provide more details so I can assist you better?

Best regards
The VidaListing Team

templates.name: General Reply
templates.subject: RE: Your enquiry
templates.body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

Thank you for getting in touch. How can I help you today?

Best regards
The VidaListing Team
